The property is situated in a quiet and well-served area of Lido di Jesolo, conveniently close to main services (supermarkets, pharmacies, transport) and is structured as follows: - Living Area: Spacious open-space living room with kitchenette directly connected to the large habitable terrace overlooking the sea. - Sleeping Area: Master Bedroom: A spacious double bedroom complete with private en-suite bathroom. Second Bedroom: Comfortable bedroom furnished with two single beds. Second Bathroom: Main bathroom serving the entire apartment. Parking Space: Private parking space reserved within the property. Contract Details: - Period: From 01/10/2026 to 30/04/2027 - Monthly Rent: €1.200 Ideal solution for commuting workers, teachers, healthcare personnel or anyone looking for quality temporary accommodation during the winter months.
